scopeNote: integration contract: Pure-Swift client conforming to FirebaseAppCheck via the Pyric WebSocket bridge. Covers AppCheck per-app singletons and setAppCheckProviderFactory, AppCheckDebugProviderFactory/AppAttestProviderFactory/DeviceCheckProviderFactory sandbox RS256 JWT minting, custom AppCheckProvider conformers, async and completion-handler token(forcingRefresh:) and limitedUseToken(), AppCheckTokenDidChange NotificationCenter events, isTokenAutoRefreshEnabled, opWithAppCheck cross-service propagation, and AppCheckErrorCode NSError bridging.
